environment.description: Kubernetes pod running the gRPC pipeline plugin as a sidecar in the CI runner namespace. The pod has unrestricted egress networking (no NetworkPolicy), the gRPC endpoint is exposed on the pod's ClusterIP without mTLS or metadata filtering. The script_loader.RemoteScriptLoader fetches any URL provided without validation. No Envoy sidecar or gRPC-Web proxy is present to filter metadata headers.
